accounting.note: The columns measure ACTIVITY HOURS; the loop ranks on CASE SPAN. `case_span_not_visible_to_any_column` is the part of the span change that no per-activity column can show — time the case spends with nothing running (fitted extraneous-delay timers, routing that sends cases down longer paths).
